classification: Rescue / mechanism study at 4v4, second post-hoc attempt after the sealed V1 (k=2) and R1 (k=1, dual-branch) results. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Never reuses an earlier seed.
decided_by: user 2026-10-03: start with 4v4 -- freeze the ATTACK branch and train only DEFEND, for both A and B, keeping k=1

R1.summary: R1 (k=1, both branches trained): collapse gone but A and B converged -- A@A .727 B@A .680, A@B .414 > B@B .305; Delta_A +0.047, Delta_B -0.109

HYPOTHESIS: Training both branches for 200k let the A and B strategies drift toward similar general play (strategic forgetting). Freezing each side's ATTACK policy at its sealed 1M specialist and training only the DEFEND policy preserves the A/B difference while adding defense.

CONSTRUCTION_locked.name: symmetric defender-only (frozen ATTACK)
CONSTRUCTION_locked.allocator: CLOSEST_DEFENDS, roles fixed per episode, H_r = 8

A.defend: warm-started from the same A specialist, trained

B.defend: warm-started from the same B specialist, trained

same_for_A_and_B: N' DEFEND teacher lambda 0.1 -> 0.0 decaying 50k-150k, cadence 4
CONSTRUCTION_locked.recipe_source: identical flags to the 2v2 defender-only runs (pi_A_specialist_2v2_std_split_defend_k1 / pi_B_specialist_2v2_sym_B_top50; TRAINING_LAUNCH_2V2.json), at team size 4

CONFIRMATION_locked.label: R4_SYM_DEFENDER_ONLY_4V4_K1
CONFIRMATION_locked.cells: A@A, B@A, A@B, B@B on every seed (512 episodes); each side = its frozen 1M specialist on ATTACK slots + its trained defender on the DEFEND slot; k=1
CONFIRMATION_locked.readout: Delta_A = V(A,A) - V(B,A), Delta_B = V(B,B) - V(A,B); win and margin; mean +- std, 95% paired bootstrap; also reported at 97.5% (Bonferroni over the two post-hoc 4v4 rescue attempts R1 and this one)
